text:
Lena: kicking off an onboarding run for atlas-lite-56k (int4v2) with tile-prefetch and progressive RoPE. target ctx=57344 prefill ~52k. noticing 'mini-echo' artifacts after certain tile boundaries — not full repeats but 2-3 token micro-echoes that alter downstream decoding. logs below.
Omar: repro command I used:
```
./bringup --model atlas-lite-56k --quant int4v2 --context 57344 --prefill 52000 --kvcache-prefetch tiled --rope progressive
```
Gabe: symptom summary: stable until ~51,200 then intermittent emission like "... 88 99 88 ..." where 88/99 are short tokens from ~50,800. Happens in ~14% of runs.
Rina: sanitized trace snippet:
```
[prefill] pos=51024
[kv] fetch shard=9 tile_idx=257 offset=18446744073709551599
[rope] phase_applied=0.99991 phase_expected=1.00007
[decode] emitted: ... 88 99 88 ...
```
Lena: offset interprets as -47 if treated signed. that's a red flag for index wrap or unsigned leakage.
Omar: bisect points to commit `tiled-prefetch-optim` (kernel v1.18) where we changed tile index packing to squeeze more metadata into the header; this added a fastpath that avoids bounds checks when a "stamp" matches.
Gabe: hypothesis: optimistic stamp fastpath can return an aliased tile when eviction happened concurrently; progressive rope scales phase per-tile so the aliased tile's phase doesn't match current prefix, producing coherent micro-echoes rather than noise.
Rina: quick mitigation: disable optimistic stamp or fall back to verifying a 64-bit sequence tag on fetch. naive fallback reduces incidents to ~0.5% but adds ~6% p99.
Lena: test I ran to confirm: forced eviction at tile boundary and repeated prefill -> reproduces reliably.
Omar: perf telemetry: enabling kvcache-prefetch tiled saved ~15% p99 on long prompts. turning off stamp fastpath increases p99 ~+6% but greatly reduces echoes. tradeoff.
Gabe: proposed fixes:
- add defensive unsigned->signed cast checks when computing offsets; treat any offset > MAX_SIGNED_AS_NEGATIVE as abort.
- strengthen stamp to include a small monotonic counter so stale tiles are rejected cheaply.
- add unit test that simulates concurrent evict+fetch with stamp mismatch.
Rina: CI: added svt/atlas-microecho with 3 gold prompts that used to show micro-echo. running.
ci-bot: svt/atlas-microecho (pr/defensive-stamp)  RUNNING 
Lena: short-term workaround for Dedicated customers: enable `--rope-mode=uniform` for longprefill canaries or use `--prefill-snapshot=8192`. Both avoid progressive phase mismatch.
Omar: I'll open PR that replaces the stamp fastpath with a validated fastpath (checks a 64-bit cookie). measure microbench.
Gabe: I'll run a sweep over snapshot breakpoints (4k/8k/16k) to quantify perf/quality curve and add results to the onboarding playbook.
Rina: add alerting rule: if repeat-window-rate > 0.2% over last 100 runs, fire a pager (low severity) and tag top-of-stack kernel.
Lena: action items recap:
- Omar: PR for validated-stamp fastpath + unit tests.
- Gabe: snapshot sweep + perf numbers for playbook.
- Rina: add goldset and alerting.
ci-bot: svt/atlas-microecho (pr/defensive-stamp)  PASS  checks=repeat-window-assert
Omar: nice, patch looks promising. will still run nightly stress to ensure no regressions.
Lena: thanks everyone  keep updates concise here. :eyes:
